title: Lockfile Generation
description: Lockfile Generation is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Generates a lockfile pinning every transitive dependency. The resolver records exact versions and hashes for the full tree. It takes manifest and produces lockfile. Tunable parameters: exact. Guarantee: the lockfile always covers transitive deps.

fields.mechanism: The resolver records exact versions and hashes for the full tree.
fields.guarantees: the lockfile always covers transitive deps

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Hash Verification
description: Hash Verification is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Verifies every downloaded package against its recorded hash. Downloads are hashed on arrival; mismatches abort the install. It takes lockfile and produces verified install. Tunable parameters: SHA-512. Guarantee: mismatched packages never install.

fields.mechanism: Downloads are hashed on arrival; mismatches abort the install.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Reproducible Builds
description: Reproducible Builds is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Rebuilds byte-identical artifacts from the same lockfile. Build inputs are fixed — versions, timestamps, ordering — so outputs hash identically. It takes lockfile and produces artifacts. Tunable parameters: deterministic. Guarantee: identical lockfiles always build identically.

fields.mechanism: Build inputs are fixed — versions, timestamps, ordering — so outputs hash identically.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Bump Proposals
description: Bump Proposals is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Proposes dependency bumps with a risk score per bump. Available updates are scored by semver distance and advisory data; safe bumps are batched. It takes lockfile, registry and produces proposals. Tunable parameters: risk scored. Guarantee: breaking bumps are never auto-applied.

fields.mechanism: Available updates are scored by semver distance and advisory data; safe bumps are batched.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Vulnerability Gates
description: Vulnerability Gates is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Blocks installs when a pinned version has a known vulnerability. Advisories are checked at install; vulnerable pins fail with the advisory ID. It takes advisories and produces gate. Tunable parameters: per install. Guarantee: vulnerable pins never install silently.

fields.mechanism: Advisories are checked at install; vulnerable pins fail with the advisory ID.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: License Snapshots
description: License Snapshots is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Snapshots the license of every pinned dependency. Licenses are recorded at freeze time; changes on bump are flagged for review. It takes lockfile and produces license report. Tunable parameters: per dep. Guarantee: license changes always flag.

fields.mechanism: Licenses are recorded at freeze time; changes on bump are flagged for review.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Offline Mirror
description: Offline Mirror is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Keeps an offline mirror of every pinned package. The mirror syncs on freeze; installs prefer the mirror and work offline. It takes lockfile and produces mirror. Tunable parameters: per freeze. Guarantee: the mirror always matches the lockfile.

fields.mechanism: The mirror syncs on freeze; installs prefer the mirror and work offline.
fields.guarantees: the mirror always matches the lockfile

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Freeze Drift Alerts
description: Freeze Drift Alerts is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Alerts when the live tree drifts from the lockfile. The tree is compared to the lockfile on every build; drift fails the build. It takes build and produces drift report. Tunable parameters: per build. Guarantee: drift never passes silently.

fields.mechanism: The tree is compared to the lockfile on every build; drift fails the build.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Multi-Platform Pins
description: Multi-Platform Pins is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Pins platform-specific binaries per target platform. Each platform gets its own pinned artifacts; the lockfile records all of them. It takes targets and produces platform pins. Tunable parameters: per OS/arch. Guarantee: a missing platform pin always fails that build.

fields.mechanism: Each platform gets its own pinned artifacts; the lockfile records all of them.
fields.guarantees: a missing platform pin always fails that build

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Rollback Points
description: Rollback Points is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Snapshots the lockfile before every bump for instant rollback. Pre-bump lockfiles are kept; rollback restores the exact previous tree. It takes bump events and produces restore points. Tunable parameters: per bump. Guarantee: rollbacks always restore exactly.

fields.mechanism: Pre-bump lockfiles are kept; rollback restores the exact previous tree.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Dependency Pruning
description: Dependency Pruning is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Removes pinned dependencies nothing uses. The tree is walked from entry points; unreachable pins are proposed for removal. It takes lockfile and produces prune list. Tunable parameters: per freeze. Guarantee: used pins are never pruned.

fields.mechanism: The tree is walked from entry points; unreachable pins are proposed for removal.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: SBOM Export
description: SBOM Export is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Exports a software bill of materials from the lockfile. Every pinned package becomes an SBOM entry with version, hash, and license. It takes lockfile and produces SBOM. Tunable parameters: SPDX. Guarantee: the SBOM always matches the lockfile.

fields.mechanism: Every pinned package becomes an SBOM entry with version, hash, and license.
fields.guarantees: the SBOM always matches the lockfile

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Canary Bumps
description: Canary Bumps is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Rolls a bump to a canary subset before the whole fleet. Canary hosts install the bump first; fleet-wide rollout needs a clean canary. It takes bump and produces canary result. Tunable parameters: 10% canary. Guarantee: failed canaries never roll out.

fields.mechanism: Canary hosts install the bump first; fleet-wide rollout needs a clean canary.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Freeze Policies
description: Freeze Policies is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Enforces org-wide freeze policies — e.g. no unpinned installs. The installer refuses any install that would bypass the lockfile. It takes policy and produces enforcement. Tunable parameters: always on. Guarantee: policy violations always fail loudly.

fields.mechanism: The installer refuses any install that would bypass the lockfile.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Time-Travel Installs
description: Time-Travel Installs is a build ability in the Autonomous Dependency Freezing database. Installs the exact tree from any past date. Historical lockfiles are kept; checking one out reproduces that day's tree. It takes history and produces old tree. Tunable parameters: per day. Guarantee: time travel never mutates the current lockfile.

fields.mechanism: Historical lockfiles are kept; checking one out reproduces that day's tree.
fields.guarantees: time travel never mutates the current lockfile

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.
